title: Gotva Prime
extract:
Gotva Prime is a standalone Prime rifle, widely used by ancient Orokin Era  Grineer soldiers during the final days of the Empire. Fully automatic with pure  Puncture damage, Status Effects from the Gotva Prime have a chance to set the next shot to 300% Critical Chance.
This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals pure  Puncture damage.
Status Effects have a 15% chance to set the next hit's Critical Chance to 300%.
The effect is triggered separately for each bullet when using Multishot, as well as each enemy hit with Punch Through.
Whether an enemy hit via Punch Through can be subject to the increased crit chance depends on whether or not the previous enemy hit was inflicted with a status effect, not whether the previous shot did.
Applying multiple status effects in a single hit does not increase the chance for the effect.
Chance remains until landing another successful shot; missed shots will not reset the chance.
Set Critical Chance ignores all other modifiers, whether from mods or Warframe abilities. However, the Vigilante set mods can increase the damage to that of a Tier-4 critical hit.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High magazine size (84)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Very high accuracy (0.00° to 0.00°)
Above average reload speed (2.00 s)
Very high ammo max (840)
Very high fire rate (13.33 attacks/sec)
Above average status chance (27.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.50x)
Disadvantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low damage per shot (33.62)
Very low total damage (25)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.85x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Gotva Prime is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  625,000 and  675. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
The weapon can be traded, but only when unranked and without Forma or Orokin Catalyst installed. The trading recipient must also have a Mastery Rank of at least 14.

History
Gotva Prime was acquired by watching TennoCon 2023 on WARFRAME's Twitch with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes, between 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, on August 26th, 2023. The drop included a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Tips
Build for the following to increase the likelihood of triggering the weapon's unique 300% critical chance effect:
Status Chance ( Thermite Rounds,  Rime Rounds,  High Voltage,  Malignant Force,  Hammer Shot,  Rifle Aptitude ( Galvanized))
Forced Status procs ( Hunter Munitions)
Multishot ( Split Chamber ( Galvanized),  Vigilante Armaments)
Punch Through ( Shred ( Primed),  Metal Auger,  Vigilante Offense,  Rifle Elementalist)

Trivia
Artwork for the Gotva Prime was first showcased during TennoCon 2019. It was also featured in the Awakening cinematic cutscene, wielded by Orokin Era Grineer.
 Aeolak appears to be a Void-warped version of the Gotva Prime, or of one in a related weapon family, as it differs in mechanics and subtle visual details. The Aeolak is also wielded by Thrax Legatus, which are Void manifestations of ancestral Grineer.
Gotva Prime is the first non-Founder exclusive Primed equipment that is not obtained through Void Relics.
Gotva Prime has an unusual reload animation, which appears to involve ejecting and replacing the entire barrel. This somewhat resembles the magazine of the Heckler & Koch G11, which slots into the front of the gun above the barrel.
It could also be based on the loading and operation of Metal Storm weapons, which have their ammunition pre-loaded into barrels and electronically fired in sequence within the barrels, allowing for extremely fast bursts at the cost of requiring barrels to be swapped to reload. The Gotva Prime's extreme rate of fire and reloading animation involving the barrel being replaced could be based on this.
Despite having Prime in the name, Baro Ki'Teer will not interact with the player as he would if you had primes equipped.
